title: Concept: Hex dependency with an open lower bound
description: mix.exs declares a `>=` requirement with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every later major satisfies the requirement, so Mix can resolve an incompatible release the project never tested.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: Every later major satisfies the requirement, so Mix can resolve an incompatible release the project never tested.
